properties.statement: A ragged range whose selected parent's offsets entry is n visits that parent's n ascending positions, independently of the padded members.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [Esm.Expr.Lits α] (lengths : Esm.Expr.Val α) (parents : List Int) (entry : α) (n : Nat), Esm.Expr.indexCell lengths parents = .ok (.num entry) → Esm.Expr.Lits.toInt? entry = some (n : Int) → Esm.Expr.raggedPositions lengths parents = .ok ((List.range n).map (fun i : Nat => 1 + (i : Int)))

properties.statement: When value invention visits a ragged row of length n, it reads the members stored at the selected parent's first n positions, in order.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [Esm.Expr.Lits α] (lengths values : Esm.Expr.Val α) (parents : List Int) (entry : α) (n : Nat), Esm.Expr.indexCell lengths parents = .ok (.num entry) → Esm.Expr.Lits.toInt? entry = some (n : Int) → Esm.Expr.raggedMembers lengths values parents = ((List.range n).map (fun i : Nat => 1 + (i : Int))).mapM (fun i => Esm.Expr.indexCell values (parents ++ [i]))

properties.statement: If the outer contracted range is empty, the query's fold preserves its seeded identity without inspecting the body or any inner bound.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [Esm.Expr.Lits α] (reverse : Bool) (step : Esm.Expr.Val α → Esm.Expr.Env α → Except Esm.Expr.EvalError (Esm.Expr.Val α)) (name : String) (bounds : Esm.Expr.Env α → Except Esm.Expr.EvalError (List Int)) (rest : List (Esm.Expr.FaqRange α)) (env : Esm.Expr.Env α) (identity : Esm.Expr.Val α), bounds env = .ok [] → Esm.Expr.faqFold reverse step ((name, bounds) :: rest) env identity = .ok identity

properties.statement: A reverse window with one contracted axis visits its declared indices from highest to lowest, applying the cell's fold step sequentially without reassociating it.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [Esm.Expr.Lits α] (step : Esm.Expr.Val α → Esm.Expr.Env α → Except Esm.Expr.EvalError (Esm.Expr.Val α)) (name : String) (bounds : Esm.Expr.Env α → Except Esm.Expr.EvalError (List Int)) (env : Esm.Expr.Env α) (identity : Esm.Expr.Val α) (values : List Int), bounds env = .ok values → Esm.Expr.faqFold true step [(name, bounds)] env identity = (values.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (b ≤ a))).foldlM (fun acc i => step acc ((name, .num (Esm.Expr.Lits.ofDec i 0)) :: env)) identity
